description: Turn a brief, a template + fields, a style + media, or an edit plan into a https://indiadigital.org/video/make/ link. Opening it renders the video in that browser and offers Download and Share. Nothing is uploaded or stored.

brief.description: What to make, in words, e.g. "30-second Diwali reel for Sharma Sweets, 20% off". Picks a template and fills fields when they are missing.

fields.description: Template field values by field id.

logo.description: https link to a logo image.

media.description: https links to photos/clips/songs (hosts must allow CORS, e.g. raw.githubusercontent.com, res.cloudinary.com).

music.description: house | cinematic | lofi | tabla | corporate | none | https link to a song.

recipe.description: A video recipe (see get_edit_plan_schema {which:"recipe"}). You can also pass its keys directly.

steps.description: Media to fetch or make in the viewer’s browser before editing (max 10 steps, 12 items). Stock: {"type":"stock","query":"indian sweets","kind":"photo|illustration|video","count":3,"orientation":"vertical"} uses Pixabay with the viewer’s free key. Generate: {"type":"generate","mode":"t2i|t2v|i2v","prompt":"…","seconds":5,"aspect":"9:16"} uses the viewer’s own AI keys or ComfyUI; they confirm the ₹ cost first. Nothing runs on this server.

style.description: Edit style for your own clips (needs media).

name: build_video_link

link.description: https://indiadigital.org/video/make/ link; the recipe travels after "#".

title: Make a video link
